analysis.pooled: equal-weight mean over all 768 paired game differences (balanced 4 seed x opponent cells)
analysis.unit: whole opening family; all seeds, opponents, colors and arms kept together

decision_rules.CONFIRMED_POSITIVE_EFFECT: no FAIL condition AND pooled difference > 0 AND pooled 95% lower > 0 AND each seed difference > -0.02 AND no opponent material regression
decision_rules.FAIL: any reproducible tactical correctness violation (guarded match decision disagrees with independent reference, tactical200 guarded avoidable/missed win, or first paired decision differs between arms); any solved300/deep128 guarded exact-WDL below control; regression-suite non-reproduction of 4D.4J-A; checkpoint/protocol integrity failure; latency failure; or demonstrated material regression: pooled difference <= -0.02 with 95% upper < 0, or any single opponent difference <= -0.02 with its 95% upper < 0
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: otherwise; a positive point estimate whose interval spans zero is never called confirmed
decision_rules.PRACTICALLY_MEANINGFUL: reported separately: pooled point estimate >= +0.02 (no +5pp requirement)
decision_rules.QUALIFIED: if seed or opponent point estimates differ in sign, the interpretation is qualified

opponents.name: negamax5
opponents.role: B stronger, selected by declared calibration rule

regression_suites: 4D.4J-A tactical200/solved300/deep128 with identical 4D.4J-A streams (regression only, not confirmation evidence)
secondary_generation20: OMITTED before freeze: different official-campaign loader not verified strict-compatible; +768 games (~470 CPU-s) would compete with primary and review budget
timing_note: four single-thread tasks run in parallel on the 10-core M4; guard timing is a CPU-local nanosecond clock separate from inference
